cohort: 280 women admitted for hysterectomy for benign gynecological conditions over a period of one year in the department of obstetrics and gynecology, Meenakshi medical college hospital and research institute
finding: The prevalence of adenomyosis in hysterectomy specimens was 16.8%, with the highest prevalence in the 41-50 year old age group, and was associated with heavy menstrual bleeding, dysmenorrhea, increased parity, and history of dilatation and curettage.
